name: Intel RealSense D435i
mpn: 82635D435IDK5P (MM# 999AFR; K38179-100 with BMI055 IMU, K38179-110 with BMI085 IMU)
description: Active-IR stereo depth camera with global-shutter imagers, 50 mm baseline, RGB camera and a 6-axis IMU over USB-C.

specs.label: Depth
specs.value: Active IR stereo, global shutter, up to 1280 × 720, 50 mm baseline

specs.label: RGB
specs.value: Rolling shutter, up to 1920 × 1080; FOV H 69° × V 42° (D 77°)

envelope.axes: x = width (left–right), y = depth (front glass to back), z = height. Tolerance ±0.15 mm; drawing shows depth 25.05 mm.

features.label: Rear mounting
features.value: 2× M3 threaded holes on the back face, 45 mm apart, centered horizontally, on the vertical center line of the 25 mm height; max screw insertion depth 3 mm; recommended torque 0.4 N·m

features.label: Tripod mount
features.value: 1× 1/4-20 UNC on the bottom face; its centerline is 17.5 mm from the left imager center. Scaled from the drawing it sits at the body's horizontal center (45 mm from either end) — the drawing does not dimension this directly.

features.label: Front apertures (lens centers)
features.value: Left and right IR imagers 50 mm apart (baseline); IR projector 29 mm from the left imager toward the right imager; RGB camera 15 mm beyond the left imager (outboard). Viewed from the front: right imager, projector, left imager, RGB. Depth origin = left imager center. With the tripod hole at body center: left imager 17.5 mm right of center (viewed from front), right imager 32.5 mm left of center, projector 11.5 mm left of center, RGB 32.5 mm right of center (derived, not drawn as such).

features.label: Depth start point
features.value: Depth origin is 4.2 mm behind the front cover glass (Z' = −4.2 mm)

features.label: USB-C
features.value: USB Type-C receptacle on one short end; side location shown in Figure 10-9 views but not dimensioned

notes: Intel spun RealSense out; old dev.intelrealsense.com no longer resolves. The official CAD page (dev.realsenseai.com/docs/cad-files, 'D400 Depth Cameras') serves a ZIP (D400-Depth-Cameras-CAD.zip, 15,041,868 bytes, files dated Oct 2023) that contains only SolidWorks .SLDPRT solids for D405/D415/D435/D435f/D435i/D455/D455f/D456/D457 — no STEP/IGES. The app cannot read SLDPRT directly: a human needs SolidWorks, eDrawings, Onshape or Fusion import to export STEP (FreeCAD cannot read SLDPRT). The datasheet weight (75 g) applies to the D43x family table; bulk cameras ship without the ~2.3 g USB cap. Amazon listing B07TWYWY18 title verified; seller/brand field not parsed, and part number 82635D435IDK5P appeared in search snippets. Older D435i units use BMI055; newer K38179-110 uses BMI085.
